method.what_this_is: A design decision over evidence gathered in this cycle: public listing pages read directly (prices, review counts, seller sales counts) plus published 2026 renovation-cost research. No paid data, no scraping, no accounts.
method.what_this_is_not: Not a demand forecast and not transaction-level proof. Review pages state 'verified buyers'; nobody outside the seller can see units sold, so volume is INFERRED, not OBSERVED.

decision.title: Renovation Allowance & Change-Order Control
decision.price_basis: OBSERVED comparable systems at $11.99, $14, $19, $27 and $49; $19 sits at the median of the paid, non-discounted tier and is the price at which an incumbent sells a directly comparable landlord system. Not a guess about what buyers will pay: it is the observed market's middle.
core_mechanism: each budget line carries approved budget, committed (signed contract or accepted quote), paid, and remaining - four numbers, not two
allowance lines are reconciled separately: allowance, selection price, difference, and whether the credit is still owed back
every change order is a row with its own approved amount, feeding a revised budget rather than editing the original
estimate-at-completion = paid + cost-to-complete, compared against the revised budget, so the projected overrun is visible while choices can still change
contingency is tracked as a separate reserve with a drawdown log, so upgrades cannot quietly consume it
decision.why_this_is_not_a_clone: The consumer listings verified this cycle compare budget to actual. This product's headline number is the one the research says is missing: what is already committed but not yet paid, plus what is still owed back on allowances, expressed as a projected final cost.
honest_limitations: No transaction-level sales data exists for any competitor; volume is INFERRED from review counts and shop sales totals.
The factory's market-realism policy counts PDF pages only and will suggest a much lower price on the general digital tier; that conflict is disclosed, not resolved silently.
Publication of this product will be blocked by the same authorization gate as B12-006 to B12-009.
